questionEn: Which conclusion on the topic “Substance and its properties” can be considered correct?
questionUz: “Modda va uning xossalari” mavzusidagi qaysi xulosani to‘g‘ri deb hisoblash mumkin?
choicesEn: Color, smell, density, melting, boiling, electrical conductivity
choicesUz: Rang, hid, zichlik, erish, qaynash, elektr o'tkazuvchanlik
explanationEn: Physical properties are perceived by the senses or measured by an instrument.
explanationUz: Jismoniy xususiyatlar sezgilar tomonidan idrok etiladi yoki asbob bilan o'lchanadi.
